mapper.sql: SELECT b.id, b.book_name AS bookName, b.author_name AS authorName, b.category_id AS categoryId, c.category_name AS categoryName, b.pic_url AS picUrl, b.book_desc AS bookDesc, b.book_status AS bookStatus, b.word_count AS wordCount, b.visit_count AS visitCount, b.chapter_count AS chapterCount, b.first_chapter_id AS firstChapterId, b.last_chapter_id AS lastChapterId, b.last_chapter_name AS lastChapterName, b.last_chapter_update_time AS lastChapterUpdateTime, b.status, b.create_time AS createTime, b.update_time AS updateTime FROM book_info b JOIN book_category c ON c.id = b.category_id WHERE b.status = 0 AND c.status = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE book_info SET visit_count = visit_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{bookId} AND status = 0
UPDATE book_info SET visit_count = visit_count + #{delta}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{bookId} AND status = 0
